To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the structure of the small-molecule inhibitor of Bcl-x(L): Bim BH3 was designed based on the comparison between Bim BH3 and ABT-737; the small-molecule inhibitors were designed to have broad-spectrum binding affinity to target proteins similar with Bim BH3; and the broad-spectrum binding of the inhibitors was critical for their anti-tumor activity.
the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a new series of broad-spectrum Bcl-2 inhibitor molecules were performed.
the broad-spectrumbinding properties of Bim BH 3 can be mimicked in small-molecule compounds, and that these compounds show strong anti-tumor activity in vitro.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of broad-spectrum, small-molecule inhibitors for the anti-apoptotic family members of Bcl-2 proteins.
the design, synthesis, and evaluation of small-molecule broad-spectrum inhibitors of the anti-apoptotic proteins Bcl-x(L).
the design, synthesis, and evaluation of broad-spectral small-molecule inhibitors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our study has provided a novel approach for developing anti-cancer agents.
the structure-based design of small-molecule Bcl-x(L)/Bcl-2/Bcl-w inhibitors has been successful, and a new class of small-molecule compounds with anti-apoptotic properties has been identified.
the broad-spectrums of Bim BH 3 binding to anti-apoptotic proteins play an important role in its anti-tumor activities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we designed and synthesized a series of novel small-molecule inhibitors with broad-spectrum binding activities to Bcl-xL, Bcl-2 and Mcl- 1, and that these small-molecule inhibitors had better anti-tumor activities than ABT- 737, a small molecule that is currently in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of hematological malignancies.
we have designed, synthesized, and evaluated a series of broad-spectrum inhibitors of anti-apoptic Bcl-2 proteins.
we have designed a novel class of small molecule inhibitors of the anti-apoptotic proteins Bcl-2 and Bcl-x(L).
The main takeaway from our work is that

the broad-spectra of the small molecule inhibitors binding to target protein play critical roles in inhibiting the tumor cells growth, and the broad-spectrum small molecule inhibitors can be designed based on the structure information of Bim BH 3.
it is feasible, and perhaps even necessary, to design small-molecules with broad-spectrum binding affinity to Bcl-xL, Bcl-2 and Mcl-11 in order to effectively inhibit the growth of tumor cells.
it is possible to design broad-spectrum small molecule inhibitors of Bcl-2 proteins based on the structure and function of Bim BH.
